on_screen_text.text: Rep. Green rips into Governor Abbott for gerrymandering Texas
DEMOCRATS ARE MAKING A DIFFERENCE, AND YES,
THEY'RE ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF HISTORY.
BUT MORE IMPORTANT THAN ALL OF THIS,
THEY'RE ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS.
WHAT THE GOVERNOR IS DOING IN TEXAS IS WRONG.
WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU GOVERNOR?
YOU'VE HAD BABIES TO LOSE THEIR LIVES,
AND YOU'RE TRYING TO REDISTRICT TEXAS?
NUMBER ONE ITEM ON YOUR SCORECARD?
WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU, GOVERNOR?
SOMEBODY'S GOT TO CALL YOU OUT.
WE'RE GONNA CALL YOU OUT NOW,
AND I BELIEVE WE'LL CALL YOU OUT NOVEMBER OF NEXT YEAR.

spoken_summary: Rep. Al Green passionately praises Democrats for being on the "right side of history" and "righteousness." He then launches into a tirade against Texas Governor Greg Abbott, repeatedly shouting, "What is wrong with you, governor?" Green accuses Abbott of prioritizing redistricting while ignoring the suffering of Texas families and the deaths of babies. He concludes by saying Abbott should be ashamed and that voters will "call you out" in the next election.

central_claim: Texas Governor Greg Abbott is shamefully prioritizing political gerrymandering over addressing the suffering and deaths of his constituents.
intended_effect: To provoke anger towards Governor Greg Abbott and portray Democrats as morally superior and focused on people's well-being.
